Queen - Complete Discography [Qobuz]
1973-2024 | Rock / Classic Rock / Opera Rock | FLAC (Qobuz) | 4 Parts
One of the most emblematic bands of the seventies' excesses, Queen embraced the pomp of progressive rock and heavy metal, as well as vaudeville and music hall, creating a kitsch and bombastic style personified by Freddie Mercury, one of the most charismatic singers in rock history.
The success of "A Night At The Opera" (1975), the band's masterpiece, transformed them into one of the most popular acts on the planet, despite never being taken seriously by critics. Only Mercury's death in 1991 could stop Queen, whose albums continued to sell in the millions. Their inextinguishable popularity reached an umpteenth peak in 2018 thanks to the success of the biopic Bohemian Rhapsody.
